about: Level 1's portal (entity portal + portalScorch), Hawkes Gen art. Replaces portal-interim.json's sheets with the same cell (466x251), pivot and frame counts (open 24, loop 32, close 24), so no data or timing changes: crop and count pin them.
gpu: Sources, in --src: portal.png = the take of image.paint j_8e77cf45dddc (3 takes, magenta plate) picked by hawkesgen_entity_judge against the Meadow art and Video2's fire tunnel (10.6-14.5 s); scorch.png = image.edit of that take (the hole burnt out to an opaque black-and-brown charred patch on the same turf; a translucent shadow keys to purple on magenta); open.mp4 = video.i2v scorch.png -> portal.png, loop.mp4 = video.i2v portal.png -> portal.png, close.mp4 = video.i2v portal.png -> scorch.png (flare and shrink), all 832x480 on the magenta plate. If a piece judges worse than the interim art, keep the interim sheet (don't bake that clip).
name: Portal
